## Summary

Stage A of **P0.15h** (`docs/tickets/16_P0.15h__…green-exit.md`) — closes the two residues P0.15g diagnosed live that block a **COMPLETE green Review**, IaC's P0.15g's live-only fixes, and proves the §12.6 boundary deny actually blocks. **Offline, no spend.** Stacked on P0.15g (PR #23). **Stage B (the live COMPLETE Review + §17 exit + G1 flag) is [OPERATOR GATE]d and NOT in this PR.**

## What changed

**Residue 1 — per-phase skill execution (primary).** Driven one phase at a time, the editorial-review skill never wrote `03-argument-notes.md` / `04-craft-notes.md` (upstream folds craft/argument into the letter; its dossier listing omits those files), so their completion predicate could never pass and the phase never committed (the live craft failure). Aligned all three seams:
- `packages/protocols/skills/editorial-review/SKILL.md` — a per-phase artifact contract + a `phase_output` input in the harness-port section; each pinned phase writes its declared file under `output_dir` before `.rhema/phase-result.json`. Upstream regimen body left verbatim.
- `packages/orchestrator/src/runspec.ts` — thread `phase_output = phase.artifacts` (manifest is the single source of the write target, so it can't drift from the oracle).
- `apps/run-task/src/harness-loop.ts` — enrich the `failStep` reason with the SDK subtype, failed leg, and the missing artifact + detail, so the server's `engine.error` event is a **REAL** observability surface for a non-committing phase (not a console line).
- `packages/protocols/src/version.ts` — `PROTOCOLS_VERSION` regenerated for the trio edit (also fixes a **pre-existing** self-check red at the P0.15g tip).

**Residue 2 — per-run budget config.** `maxUsdPerRun` is now deploy-configurable (`apps/api` `MAX_USD_PER_RUN` → `runSpecConfig`), keeping `DEFAULT_MAX_USD_PER_RUN` the fallback and `capCredits` the **hard outer ceiling**. Sizes the per-phase SDK brake so an opus-tier phase isn't cut off mid-work (`Reached maximum budget ($1.2)` live).

**Residue 3 — the boundary is a TRUE zero.** `hook-enforcement.test.ts` drives the real agent-side hook → real socket daemon → real compiled Editor `SeatPolicy` and asserts a Write to the read-only `correspondence/` mount resolves to `permissionDecision:"deny"` **in the wrapper the vendored SDK needs to block** (the D-P0.06-1 contract), and `agents/editor/**` is allowed. `privsep-check.sh` adds the independent kernel backstop: a read-only bind mount blocks a write even by uid `agent` (EROFS) — verified in the real container.

**Residue 4 — IaC-ify the live-only fixes.** `compute.ts` adds a `proxy-ingress-pods` firewall sourced from the cluster's actual `clusterIpv4Cidr` (replacing the hand-added `…-proxy-ingress-pods-p0-15g` and the stale hardcoded `10.92/14` in `network.ts` — the two had drifted; the live range was `10.236/14`), and sets the worker `DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY` env. `pulumi tsc` clean. The throwaway `integration/src/live-*` helpers are not in this PR.
